gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-puritan: Puritan reads soft and friendly, its sans forms wide open. Metamorphous is the one with presence, its slim horizontals and weightier verticals giving headings a measured swagger, while Puritan simply keeps the text easy to follow.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-questrial: Crisp and flat, Questrial looks stencil-cut, with tall lowercase and open curves. Metamorphous, with its fine thread-against-yarn weight shifts, adds the swagger above it.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-radio-canada: Commanding Metamorphous brings moderate thick-thin shifts to the top of the page, giving every heading a distinct presence. And Radio Canada follows in sans strokes that look cut from one ribbon, with curves left clearly open.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-saira: Bold and a little playful, Autour One looks laser-cut from a single width of line. Saira keeps its s open and its round letters tall, so body text stays crisp, and a modest size works well.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-radio-canada-big: Distinctive Metamorphous carries hairlines that are neither wispy nor heavy, a high midline and generous spacing around each letter. Radio Canada Big, monoline and tall, keeps a long read steady.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Noto Sans Tai Le tapers its ink strokes out before they touch, which keeps the sans text approachable. Yet Eater, dark and aggressive with wide gaps between letters, is where the pair gets its edge.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Whimsical Flavors holds a constant, stencil-channel weight, with towering lowercase and diagonals as hefty as its stems. But Noto Sans Tai Tham crowds its chalk-board sans letters upward, so the two sit together like a joke and its straight man.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-cuneiform: Futuristic Audiowide keeps a tube-like thickness through every bend, with letters spaced like tiles. Noto Sans Cuneiform has swollen, glass-bead lowercase, and a generous body size lets those open e shapes breathe.
gen-almendra-display-gf-lexend-mega: Ornate and bookish, Almendra Display has a pronounced x-height and letters that never pinch shut, while its curves and stems vary in weight. Lexend Mega, drawn as if with one nib, reads smoothly down a page.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-tiktok-sans: Expressive Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes of one width. TikTok Sans does the quieter work, its tall x-height and spacious c opening carrying the text.
